router_done_to_moe_combine_start.includes: GPU expert setup/matmul, the shared expert, routed-table transfers and dispatch gaps.

pipeline_path.interpretation: Inferred from ordered stage copy milestones and the latest two known predecessors. Endpoint stages use kernel boundaries. Residual spans can contain CPU submission, runtime overhead, or work on other streams. This is not a CUDA DAG or an avoidable-time estimate.

limitations: Copy anchors are inferred from repeated FP32 residual bytes, order and stage stream consistency. Relay gap can include waiting for other work on the receiving stage.
Kernel categories are name based. An MMQ kernel name can occur outside routed experts. Kernel sums across GPUs overlap.
Device fractions are traced time coverage. Lost events and profiling overhead can change observed intervals and timing.
